exposure: Isolated abdominal circumference < 10th percentile for gestational age
cohort: 635 singleton pregnancies with growth ultrasounds at a single health system
finding: Diagnosing fetal growth restriction (FGR) based on isolated abdominal circumference < 10th percentile led to a higher number of FGR cases but was associated with better obstetric and neonatal outcomes compared to using estimated fetal weight < 10th percentile.
